label: Split Brand
description: Split authentication: brand story on one half, form on the other. For products that want a welcome panel without glass-card theatrics.
signatureMotif: half brand panel, half crisp form, no floating glass card
promptHints: Desktop is 50/50: left (or right) is brand — name, one sentence, one still or color field. The other half is the form on a plain surface.
Mobile stacks brand as a short header, then the form. Do not hide the form behind a modal.
Keep auth states (error, pending, password rules) obvious. Brand must not steal focus from the fields.

layouts: lg:grid-cols-2 min-h-screen. Brand pane: large product name, 1–2 lines of welcome, optional muted photo or solid brand color. Form pane: title, fields, submit, and a text link to the other auth route.
Form width is max-w-sm, left-aligned in its pane with consistent 12–16px gaps. No card chrome around the form — the pane is the surface.
Legal and SSO sit under the primary button as text links or a single stacked Google/GitHub row, not a third column.
Error text is inline under the field, 14px, not a toast-only flow.
motifs: Brand pane can be dark or a saturated brand color; form pane stays high-contrast and quiet.
Sora or Geist for the brand name; Inter for labels. One radius (0.5rem) on inputs only.
No extra illustration mascots. If a photo is used it is cropped and low-contrast so type stays readable.
antiPatterns: Do not center a floating glass-modern card on a gradient mesh.
Avoid clean-auth single-column beige form with no brand pane on desktop.
No full-page marketing hero above the form, and no dashboard chrome around login.
